items.question: Within how many womb-diagrams are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these locations are tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across the vast expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject of 'pīḍitāḥ' is not explicitly named in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
